falsifier_requirement.trigger: Any expected verdict appears in visible inputs, source hashes drift, fewer than 20 holdout cases are scored, or the incumbent comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Predeclare static source and property features, then fit a training-only calibrated classifier for expected verification verdict; score each holdout program exactly once.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: property-family majority and public verifier-result comparator
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Use the better preregistered comparator between training-stratum majority verdict and a pinned public SV-COMP result table for an incumbent verifier, scored on the same hidden cases.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Implement or repair the exact domain scorer until the downstream scoring artifact passes or remains honestly fail-closed with a narrower research blocker.

required_source_block.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
required_source_block.source_name: NIST SAMATE Software Assurance Reference Dataset

residual_requirement.formula: 0/1 verdict error per program; macro error by benchmark family

target_variable.extraction_rule: Expected verdict and CWE/weakness labels remain hidden until predictions are materialized from source text, property file, and training-only metadata.
target_variable.name: heldout_program_verification_verdict

uncertainty_requirement.metric: 0/1 verdict error per program; macro error by benchmark family
uncertainty_requirement.rule: Wilson interval for error rate plus family-stratified bootstrap

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
